sehemu: Part II: High Court of the United Republic
jina: High Court of the United Republic and its jurisdiction
maudhui: (1) There shall be a High Court of the United Republic (hereinafter referred to as the “High Court”) whose jurisdiction shall be as specified in this Constitution or in any other law. (2) Where this Constitution or any other law does not expressly provide that a matter of a specified kind shall first be heard by a court of a specified level, the High Court shall have jurisdiction to hear every such matter and to exercise any function which, according to legal practice applicable in Tanzania, is ordinarily exercised by a High Court; provided that this subarticle shall apply without prejudice to the jurisdiction of the Court of Appeal of Tanzania as specified in this Constitution or any other law.
